tool_input.command:
git add CHANGELOG.md && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(docs): scope the CHANGELOG's fsync-rollback entries to which case each covered (PR #509, Bugbot finding)

The prior CHANGELOG entry for the sync-failure fsync fix read "That
truncate-back rollback is now itself fsynced" -- unqualified, immediately
after a bullet that frames the rollback as covering both the write and
sync cases. Read on its own, it overclaimed a guarantee the write-failure
path didn't have yet at that point in the branch's history.

Both entries now name which of the two rollback cases they cover and
point at each other, so the claim is unambiguous whether read together
or standalone, and the final entry states explicitly that both cases are
now fsynced -- true against the finished code (rollbackTruncate is
called from both sites in seal.go).
EOF
)"
